# Naheel Muhammed PK
> Full Stack Developer (.NET, React, Web) with project case studies, resume, and writing on naheel.me.

Naheel is a full stack developer. This site contains portfolio projects with detailed case studies, technical skills, a resume, and blog posts.

## Portfolio
- [Home](https://www.naheel.me/): Introduction and featured work.
- [Projects](https://www.naheel.me/projects): All portfolio projects with case studies. Each project has its own page at /projects/[slug] covering the build, technologies, and outcome.
- [Skills](https://www.naheel.me/skills): Technical skills and tools.
- [Resume](https://www.naheel.me/resume): Professional background and experience.
- [About](https://www.naheel.me/about): Background and contact information.
- [Contact](https://www.naheel.me/contact): Ways to get in touch.

## Writing
- [Blog](https://www.naheel.me/blog): Articles on development topics. Posts live at /blog/[slug].
- [RSS feed](https://www.naheel.me/rss.xml): Subscribe to new articles.

## Elsewhere
- [GitHub](https://github.com/naheel0): Source code and repositories.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/naheel-muhammed/): Professional profile and work history.
